name: ml
title: Machine learning and interpretability
summary: PyTorch, JAX, Transformers, and interpretability and evaluation libraries. No model weights are included, and runs have no network: weights and datasets must be in the data area first (the owner fetches or imports them).
gpu: optional; without one, only small models are practical. 8 GB of GPU memory or more for real work

tools.name: pytorch
tools.does: tensors, automatic differentiation and neural networks; uses the GPU only in runs where the owner allows it

tools.name: jax
tools.does: NumPy-style arrays with automatic differentiation and compilation (CPU build)
tools.usage: python: import jax, jax.numpy as jnp
tools.check: python -c "import jax; print('dfdx', float(jax.grad(lambda x: x**3)(2.0)))"

tools.name: transformers
tools.does: loads and runs transformer models and tokenizers from files in the data area (HF_HOME=/data/hf)
tools.usage: python: from transformers import AutoModelForCausalLM, AutoTokenizer
tools.check: python -c "import transformers, datasets, accelerate, safetensors; print('transformers ok')"

tools.name: transformer-lens
tools.does: mechanistic interpretability: run a model with hooks on every activation, patch and ablate
tools.usage: python: from transformer_lens import HookedTransformer, HookedTransformerConfig
tools.check: python -c "import torch; from transformer_lens import HookedTransformer, HookedTransformerConfig as C; m=HookedTransformer(C(n_layers=1,d_model=16,n_ctx=8,d_head=4,n_heads=4,d_vocab=10,act_fn='relu')); _,c=m.run_with_cache(torch.tensor([[1,2,3]])); print('hooks', 'blocks.0.attn.hook_pattern' in c)"

tools.name: sae-lens
tools.does: sparse autoencoders for finding features in model activations: train and analyse

tools.name: nnsight
tools.does: inspect and intervene on the internals of PyTorch models

tools.name: inspect
tools.does: framework for writing and running evaluations of AI systems (Inspect, from the UK AI Security Institute). Calling a hosted model needs network, which runs do not have

tools.name: einops, jaxtyping
tools.does: readable tensor reshaping and typed tensor shapes
tools.check: python -c "import einops, jaxtyping, numpy; print('shape', einops.rearrange(numpy.zeros((2,3)), 'a b -> b a').shape)"
